summary: testSubmittedPromptReportsNoPromptContent only exercises sendNewChatPrompt (first message of a brand-new chat); it never exercises PiConversationModel.sendDraft()'s onPromptSubmitted callback wired via AppModel.installRuntimeCallbacks (AppModel.swift:1054-1056), which is the path used for every ordinary message sent in an existing conversation, so a regression that stops reporting prompt_submitted there would not be caught.
